note: Storage namespaces describe storage domains, not independent generic cloud drives. API-family mappings are associations requiring product entitlement and endpoint verification.

children.name: Adobe Cloud Storage and Collaboration
children.responsibility: Shared cloud-storage and collaboration metadata; product-specific storage access must be verified.
children.api_boundary: No universal Adobe Drive or generic file CRUD API is implied.

children.name: Adobe Creative Cloud Storage
children.responsibility: Cloud documents, supported project references and Creative Cloud Library relationships.
children.api_boundary: Desktop applications are not automatically exposed as general-purpose file APIs.

children.name: Adobe Creative Cloud Assets Storage
children.responsibility: Reusable creative assets, metadata, ownership, sharing and version references.
children.api_boundary: Use only documented asset operations and authorized scopes.

children.name: Adobe Document Cloud Storage
children.responsibility: Document Cloud files and document lifecycle metadata.
children.api_boundary: PDF processing and e-signature APIs are not automatically general file-storage APIs.

children.name: Adobe Experience Manager Assets Storage
children.responsibility: Enterprise DAM assets, metadata, renditions, collections and permissions.
related_api_families: Requires separate Experience Manager API validation
children.api_boundary: Do not assume Experience Platform APIs are interchangeable with Experience Manager Assets APIs.

children.name: Adobe Express Storage
children.responsibility: Express projects, graphics, brand assets and published-content references.
related_api_families: No dedicated Express storage API asserted in current API catalog
children.api_boundary: Verify documented API support and entitlement before implementation.

children.name: Adobe Frame.io Storage
children.responsibility: Media assets, versions, review links, comments and approvals.
children.api_boundary: Use Frame.io-specific API capabilities and authorization.

children.name: Adobe Lightroom Storage
children.responsibility: Lightroom cloud photo/video assets, albums and sync metadata.
related_api_families: Requires validation of supported Lightroom API
children.api_boundary: Do not infer generic storage CRUD or account entitlement.

children.name: Adobe Workfront Storage
children.responsibility: Project asset references, proofs, approvals and attachments.
children.api_boundary: Distinguish Workfront workflow records from the service that stores binary assets.
